result.title: Continuous Memory Machines
result.comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Personalized, Aligned, Long-Term Memory for AI Systems (PALM)
result.summary: Recurrent neural networks typically compress information into a single vector-valued recurrent state, forcing short-term computation and long-term retention to share the same representation. Past extensions alleviate this bottleneck by increasing the memory capacity or separating timescales, but lack the combination of rapid neuron-level processing and longer-term retention found in biology. To that end, we introduce the Continuous Memory Machine (CMM), a recurrent architecture with matrix-valued short- and long-term memory states serving distinct functional roles. Building on the Continuous Thought Machine (CTM), the CMM's short-term memory tracks recent neural activity, with uniquely parameterized neuron-level models learning to use these activity patterns for computation. A persistent long-term memory stores information for later use, with a Transformer jointly updating both memory stores, providing an expressive bidirectional read--write mechanism such that each store can reorganize its own contents and both read from and write to the other. Across algorithmic, in-context learning, and recurrent reasoning tasks, the CMM outperforms a broad suite of baselines, exhibiting stronger generalization than prior memory-augmented networks while preserving the CTM's interpretable attention patterns. Code is available at https://github.com/SakanaAI/continuous-memory-machines.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Continuous Memory Machine（CMM），在 Continuous Thought Machine 基础上把循环状态拆成矩阵型的短期与长期记忆，并由 Transformer 联合读写更新，在算法、上下文学习和循环推理任务上超过多个记忆增强基线并保持可解释注意力。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「短期计算状态与长期保持状态分离、双向读写」的循环状态设计，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的更新与贡献分配提供可核查的线索，但论文为纯文本/算法任务，尚无视觉证据或 THINK/LOOK/STOP 相关验证。
